subject: [PATCH v6 3/3] mm: zswap: drop cold writeback folios via swap dropbehind

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch improves the zswap writeback process by dropping cold writeback folios via swap dropbehind. It addresses a problem where folios are left on the LRU for reclaim, wasting resources and keeping cold memory resident longer than necessary. The patch allocates the folio off the LRU, marks it PG_dropbehind to free it from the swap cache once writeback completes, and clears the PG_active flag after allocation to prevent issues with page freeing. This approach is a workaround until a fix for evaluating refaults on writeback buffers can be implemented.
